description: A single-use proof that a human consented to ONE docstatus-changing act on ONE document. Minted by a human OFF this credential's reach and landed here as a HASH only — reading every row on this site must not yield a token anyone can spend. The guard refuses a submit/cancel/amend from a require_consent credential unless a live, matching, unburned marker exists, and burns it on use. This exists because scoping a credential to exactly the calls it makes does not stop whoever holds that credential from making those calls: the broker must be allowed to submit invoices, so its key can submit invoices. Possession of the key was permission to post; now it is not.

fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: The DocType this consent is bound to. Named ref_doctype because 'doctype' is reserved on every frappe document.

fields.label: Document
fields.description: The one document this consent authorises. Consent for one document is never consent for another.

fields.label: Act
fields.description: The one act this consent authorises. Cancel reverses GL entries, so consent to post is not consent to reverse: a submit marker never spends on a cancel. Required — a marker that names no act binds to nothing and always refuses.

fields.label: Token Hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the consent token. The token itself is shown once, to a human, on the broker host, and is never stored here.

fields.label: Expires At
fields.description: Hard expiry. An unreadable or absent expiry is treated as expired — a marker whose lifetime cannot be established is never spendable.

fields.label: Expires At (epoch seconds)
fields.description: The AUTHORITATIVE expiry: the true instant, in epoch seconds, fixed at mint. The Datetime above is the human-readable rendering of the same moment and is only consulted for markers minted before this field existed. Epoch seconds carry no timezone, so a DST transition, an unreadable site zone, or an administrator changing System Settings.time_zone cannot re-time a live marker -- all three of which could, when the naive Datetime was the only source.

fields.label: Burned
fields.description: Set when the marker is spent. Single-use: an unburned marker is a replay waiting to happen.

fields.label: Minted By
fields.description: The principal that landed this marker. Must NOT be the credential the marker authorises — if the broker's own key can mint markers, a stolen key mints its own permission.

name: Pacioli Consent Marker
